initialization_and_cleanup_obligations.description: Custom mainCRTStartup / WinMainCRTStartup must align RSP to 16-byte boundary before SSE2/AVX2 instructions.
Must invoke __security_init_cookie() and provide __security_check_cookie + __guard_check_icall_fptr when /GS and /guard:cf are retained with /NODEFAULTLIB.
Must define extern "C" int _fltused = 0x9875 for floating-point codegen under Windows x64 ABI.
Must supply freestanding memcpy, memset, and memcmp compiled with -fno-builtin so LTO does not emit unresolved UCRT symbol references.
Must walk .CRT$XCA through .CRT$XCZ or statically forbid non-trivial global constructors and thread_local variables.
Must drain D3D12 direct queue fence, release all COM pointers, destroy HWND, and call ExitProcess(exit_code) explicitly.

measurements.notes: Enabling -DNW_ENABLE_CRT_ELIMINATION_EXPERIMENT=ON adds /NODEFAULTLIB /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup in cmake/BuildProfiles.cmake without providing custom mainCRTStartup or security-cookie/CFG runtime stubs, so linking fails before producing an executable; byte measurements are recorded as null rather than invented numbers.

diagnostics.summary: Passing /NODEFAULTLIB /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup while retaining /GS and /guard:cf requires custom mainCRTStartup, __security_cookie, __security_check_cookie, __guard_check_icall_fptr, _fltused, and freestanding string/memory intrinsics not linked in the baseline.
diagnostics.preservation_statement: CRT elimination remains disabled by default (NW_ENABLE_CRT_ELIMINATION_EXPERIMENT=OFF); this record preserves the exact reproducible CMake command, obligations, and linker requirements without claiming unmeasured byte counts or silently stripping security mitigations.

unavailable_measurements.reason: Naive /NODEFAULTLIB without custom entry/security-cookie stubs does not produce a linked executable, and Windows 11 clang-cl/lld-link is not installed on the current Linux host.
No linked PE executable is produced without custom CRT/security-cookie support stubs, and Windows 11 clang-cl/lld-link is not installed on the current Linux host.
